title: Nonparametric LLM Evaluation from Preference Data

bias_targets.methodology: Using debiased machine learning (DML) and deriving the efficient influence function (EIF) to correct for plug-in bias when estimating generalized average ranking scores (GARS) from preference probabilities.

Modeling a position-bias term within the Bradley-Terry ranking model and symmetrizing directional scores across both display orders to account for the order in which LLM responses are presented to evaluators.
